pairs.subject: time-travel-replay
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/index.tsx:55 The module's whole surface is five design tabs (features, map, playtime, density, travel) over static design data. A case-insensitive search of every file under sub_world for replay, scrubber, playback, playhead and seekTo found 0 hits, and there was also no keyframe or requestAnimationFrame code, so nothing re-presents a persisted run on a clock the viewer controls and the subject's precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/travel/ProgressionTimeline.tsx:12 The only 'timeline' here is a static Gantt of zone progression built from hardcoded design constants. It is not derived from timestamped run records, so it is not a replay timeline.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/travel/ProgressionTimeline.tsx:20 The 'current day' marker is a fixed constant. There is no play, pause, seek or speed control and no mapping from replay position to record timestamps.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/_shared/CountUp.tsx:23 CountUp only eases a live badge tally toward its new value. It is not a counter rebuilt at a replay position, so the rule about not showing the ending at frame zero has nothing to apply to.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/index.tsx:49 The only time-like interaction is a what-if scenario with Try/Undo. There is no live stream feed and no replay feed that could share or fork a renderer.
